editorial:
Imagine getting out of prison only to find out there is a target on your back and the only person you care about is a daughter who barely knows you. That is the setup here. You follow Nate, a tough guy who has made a lot of mistakes, and his 11-year-old daughter, Polly. The movie feels like a high-stakes road trip where they are constantly running for their lives. It is not just about the chases, though. You get to see this broken father try to earn his daughter's trust while teaching her how to survive in a world where everyone is out to get them. It has a gritty, street-level energy that keeps you on edge from the start.

The action scenes are punchy and realistic, and the chemistry between the father and daughter really sells the emotional side of the story. While some of the plot twists feel a bit familiar, the pacing is tight enough that you will not get bored. If you enjoy stories about family bonds and intense shootouts, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Nate lures his enemies into a trap to protect Polly. After a brutal fight, he takes down the main villain who had been hunting them. Instead of running away again, Nate chooses to turn himself in for his past crimes to ensure Polly has a safe, normal life. The movie ends with a touching scene where Polly visits him, showing that they have finally healed their relationship and found a way to be a family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-stakes thrillers and stories about fathers and daughters.
